prior_source: Stage45 every source-complete USD-M symbol-date all 5400, 3465 valid, 437 distinct WATCH symbol-dates, 936 original V4 WATCH events (499 repeated)
cohort: ALL source-complete first-and-repeated D0 WATCH coin-dates, including ordinary non-2x normal and all 41 2x; no outcome-based inclusion or selection
data_source: Binance USD-M public official daily 1m ZIP+official .CHECKSUM, each re-fetch must reproduce identical original Stage45 daily publisher SHA and 1440 contiguous bars
observation_clock: t = original D0 WATCH recorded observed UTC; use only 1m bars opening t-61m through t-1m closed before t; no 1m high or close at/after t as a feature

features.q15_USDT: sum quote volume of minutes t-15 through t-1
features.q45_prior_USDT: sum quote volume of minutes t-60 through t-16
features.trade_count15: sum actual minute recorded number-of-trades of t-15..t-1
features.ret_since_first_watch_pct: current last closed 1m close / first WATCH last closed close -1, ONLY if current event index >=2
features.minutes_since_previous_watch: gap between original D0 timestamps, first event NULL
features.category: first vs repeated watch; 2x true high first crossing only used AFTER features extracted to group pre/post; non2x background full168h
features.raw_original_watch_count: read original event WATCH_UTC full list, including any post-2x repeated events

validity: full 5400 original ID parity; original sha for 437 source cases verified; official minute SHA equals original 9-day proof; no missing 1m or fabricated quote/trades; hard fail on mismatch
stop_conditions: WATCH timestamp not minute boundary or outside frozen window
instrument venue incorrectly treated as Spot
outputs: all 936 rows at exact original D0 WATCH time with per-event official publisher SHA
per 437 coin-date source receipts and full first/repeated time grouping
descriptive median/quantiles first vs second pre-cross vs normal
assessment: RESEARCH_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY; no candidate filtering, thresholds, holdout success, BUY/return claims
upcoming: Only after descriptive facts freeze a genuinely new state-machine priority hypothesis, with a NEW untouched date protocol and independent review; no production
